notes.title: Enhanced guidance, etc
notes.notes:
1. Strengthened guidance and provided pop-up reminders for important matters
2. Execution and assassination have added reminder icons
3. Made some optimizations to the UI menu
4. Remove the night vision filter
5. The brightness of the screen has been slightly increased, and the overall brightness can also be set in the menu
6. Some operations have been optimized, such as opening backpacks and increasing the detection range of interactions
7. Optimized some actions.
8. Updated some text.
The next thing to do is to better express the plot, as fragmentation is too severe now.

notes.title: Fixed the bug of selecting levels.
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug of selecting levels.
2. Added asynchronous loading of levels.

notes.title: Added the ability to select levels
notes.notes:
Now you can find the Select level button in the main menu, and select the door you want to go to after entering the map. Add this feature because maybe my game is not fun enough right now? I want you to be able to play the game as much as you want, and I want to know if there's something wrong with my gameplay or what I'm doing right.
Next, I will try to find ways to make my game more interesting, and I really hope you can give me your comments or suggestions.

notes.title: 03.19，在设置里面可随时选择难度
notes.notes:
1. In the settings, you can choose the difficulty at any time, and switching difficulty requires clicking agree.
2. After the AI falls to the ground, it will not suddenly stand up and can be executed with peace of mind (execution can cause a lot of damage and is very effective against elite monsters), but some boss level monsters have high health, so the game still focuses on escape.
3. Character rolling makes it easier to trigger perfect evasion
4. Increase the attack distance of counterattack after dodging
5. Optimization of actions for some monsters
6. Partial text optimization
Next, optimize the AI behavior of the monster.

notes.title: Updated on March 17
notes.notes:
1. Added key modification
2. Task guidance has been optimized
3. Added some text
Players reflect that the feel is not good, there are problems with the skin material, I will actively modify it next. Thank you all for your comments and support.
In terms of gameplay, I wanted to create a chase oriented effect with little combat. So there are not many bullets, and the elite monster above the blood is very thick, want to kill all is very difficult. I would also love to see your suggestions on gameplay.
